details: The U.S. economy experienced 23,000 job losses in July, with previous months' figures also revised downwards. This weaker labor market, alongside expectations for a slightly lower July Consumer Price Index (CPI) — projected at 3.4% compared to June's 3.5% — is signaling to analysts that the Federal Reserve may opt against further interest rate hikes. Such a shift in monetary policy would generally be considered favorable for risk assets.
title: US July Job Losses and Softer Inflation Outlook Could Influence Fed

details: U.S. spot Bitcoin Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) have recorded five consecutive days of net inflows, with $98.85 million on August 7 alone. Similarly, spot Ethereum ETFs attracted $49.60 million, extending their inflow streak to four trading days. In the week ending August 7, Bitcoin ETFs saw total weekly inflows of $844 million, and Ethereum ETFs garnered $244 million. This institutional demand is complemented by a significant trend of Bitcoin whales accumulating the cryptocurrency for three straight weeks, a pattern historically associated with market bottoms.
title: Strong Institutional Inflows into Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs

details: The Digital Asset Market Clarity (CLARITY) Act, a proposed bill intended to establish a federal regulatory framework for digital assets in the U.S., faces a procedural Senate vote on September 15. The legislation's progress has been hindered by ongoing disagreements over crucial provisions concerning ethics, stablecoin rewards, decentralized finance (DeFi), and the allocation of regulatory authority. The odds of the bill passing in 2026 have significantly dropped to just 14%.
title: US Crypto Regulation Bill Faces September Vote Delay, Uncertainty for US Crypto Regulation

details: The European Union's transitional period for crypto-asset service providers under the Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation officially concluded on July 1, 2026. Consequently, any firms operating within the EU without full MiCA authorization are now in violation of EU law. Reports indicate that only approximately 18% of the numerous virtual asset service providers that existed previously managed to secure the required full authorization.
title: EU MiCA Deadline Passes, Unlicensed Crypto Firms in Breach of Law

details: Despite a pause in rate increases in July, the European Central Bank (ECB) is widely expected to raise its deposit rate by 0.25 percentage points at its upcoming meeting on September 9. Market indicators currently show an 86% probability of such a hike. This anticipated move is driven by the ECB's ongoing efforts to combat persistent inflation, which remains influenced by elevated energy prices and evolving geopolitical tensions.
title: ECB Poised for September Rate Hike Amid Persistent Inflation

details: China's economy showed signs of steady improvement in July, with notable increases in offline consumption and an improved investment structure. However, the nation's Gross Domestic Product (GDP) growth slowed to 4.3% in Q2 2026, and concerns persist regarding prolonged domestic economic weakness, a slumping property market, and high youth unemployment, leading to a reliance on subsidized exports. In response, the People's Bank of China (PBOC) has unveiled a 2026-2030 reform plan aimed at strengthening its financial sector and expanding the international use of the renminbi.
title: China's Economy Exhibits Mixed Signals, Central Bank Plans Financial Opening-Up
